# Slender Pins

> Slender Pins are an underground rock band from London, UK. They make post-punk, big beat and surf rock, influenced by the Stooges, the Velvet Underground and Gang of Four. Members: Ash (vocals), Alex (guitar, co-songwriter), Ed (drums) and Dan (bass). Songwriting is by Alex and Ash.

## Music
- [Get Your Hooks In Me](https://open.spotify.com/track/38F0Hjm4U0DsQ585GNZTkF): lead single, disco-punk, music video filmed at Dublin Castle, Camden. Lead track from the EP Hell Is Nervous.
- [So Happy (90% Of The Time)](https://open.spotify.com/track/0WZCrxRzOlMgVGVcssCdK7)
- [Apprentice To Life](https://open.spotify.com/track/2QqLM0ZQ50YHGAt3CCxMlX)
- [Bandcamp](https://slenderpins.bandcamp.com/)
- [Spotify artist page](https://open.spotify.com/artist/18YAsKKoVqnkFvn2el3D5Q)
